        break

    print(f"  ID: {car.rental_id}, Status: {car.status}, Class: {car.car_class}")
    print(f"  Pickup: {car.pickup_date}, Total: {car.total_price}, Daily: {car.daily_rate}")

now = datetime(2026, 6, 15, 10, 0, 0)

# Apply hotel cancellation policy
# Policy: Standard room, 48+ hours before check-in = free cancellation
if hotel and hotel.status == "confirmed":
    check_in_dt = datetime.fromisoformat(hotel.check_in)
    hours_until = (check_in_dt - now).total_seconds() / 3600
    print(f"Hours until hotel check-in: {hours_until:.0f}")
    
    room_type_lower = hotel.room_type.lower()
    if "suite" in room_type_lower:
        # Suite: non-refundable
        hotel.cancellation_fee = hotel.total_price
        hotel.refund_amount = 0
    elif hours_until >= 48:
        # Standard, 48+ hours: free cancellation
        hotel.cancellation_fee = 0
        hotel.refund_amount = hotel.total_price
    elif hours_until >= 24:
        # Standard, 24-48 hours: 50% of first night
        fee = int(hotel.nightly_rate * 0.5)
        hotel.cancellation_fee = fee
        hotel.refund_amount = hotel.total_price - fee
    else:
        # Standard, <24 hours: full first night
        hotel.cancellation_fee = hotel.nightly_rate
        hotel.refund_amount = hotel.total_price - hotel.nightly_rate
    
    hotel.status = "cancelled"
    print(f"Hotel cancelled: fee={hotel.cancellation_fee}, refund={hotel.refund_amount}")

# Apply car rental cancellation policy
# Policy: 24+ hours before pickup = free; luxury/SUV get $50 surcharge
if car and car.status == "confirmed":
    pickup_dt = datetime.fromisoformat(car.pickup_date)
    hours_until_car = (pickup_dt - now).total_seconds() / 3600
    print(f"Hours until car pickup: {hours_until_car:.0f}")
    
    car_class_lower = car.car_class.lower()
    surcharge = 50 if car_class_lower in ("luxury", "suv") else 0
    
    if hours_until_car >= 24:
        # Free cancellation (+ surcharge if luxury/SUV)
        car.cancellation_fee = surcharge
        car.refund_amount = car.total_price - surcharge
    else:
        # One day charge + surcharge
        fee = car.daily_rate + surcharge
        car.cancellation_fee = fee
        car.refund_amount = car.total_price - fee
    
    car.status = "cancelled"
    print(f"Car cancelled: fee={car.cancellation_fee}, refund={car.refund_amount}")

# Save back to world.db
